subject: Post-call readout: SOC2/Retention & next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@veritasbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call readout: SOC2/Retention & next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap so we have alignment and clear next steps.

Key pain points you called out:
- Audit and retention: Veritas needs 7+ years of immutable audit logs for a subset of payment flows.
- Evidence for procurement: SOC 2 Type II artifacts, pen test summary, and retention-config screenshots are required for the risk committee.
- DPA and data residency: legal requires a DPA with EU data residency options and KMS controls (customer-managed KMS preferred).

Goals we agreed on:
1) Provide redacted SOC 2 Type II report + pen test executive summary for initial review (week of Nov 8).
2) Demo retention/audit UI and how immutable logs map to your retention policy (short demo next week).
3) Share a Mutual Action Plan with milestones for a Jan pilot (MVP) and production readiness by end of Q1.

Immediate asks for Veritas:
- Confirm which environments need EU residency vs US.
- Share a contact for legal (DPA redline) and procurement cadence.

What Redwood will deliver this week:
- Draft Mutual Action Plan (attached)
- SOC2 summary link and pen test summary (redacted) — collecting redacted artifacts now
- Proposed demo times (I added a poll link in HubSpot)

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.md (draft)

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
- Elena: confirm EU vs US scope and legal contact by Thu Nov 5
- Veritas security: confirm which artifacts (SOC2, pen test, retention screenshots) are acceptable in redacted form
- Redwood: deliver initial artifacts and schedule retention demo by Nov 10

Thanks — I’ll loop in LAURA/ADITYA for the technical artifact path and timeline.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@veritasbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@veritasbank.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call readout: SOC2/Retention & next steps

Thanks Jordan — helpful summary. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- EU scope: Payroll and settlement flows must remain in EU region; everything else can be US.
- KMS: We prefer customer-managed keys for anything that leaves our VPC. Is that supported in Private deployment?
- Pen test: the security committee will accept a pen test executive summary and remediation log; they do not need raw findings but will want evidence that critical findings were remediated.

Can you also confirm whether retention/export of audit logs can be done to our S3 (read-only bucket) for long-term archiving?

I looped in Tom (in Ops) for technical scheduling. We can do a 30m retention demo next Wed (Nov 10) morning PST.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — will share legal contact for DPA by EOD Thu.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Risk & Compliance | Veritas Bank
elena@veritasbank.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call readout: SOC2/Retention & next steps — technical plan

Thanks — copying a short technical plan and what we can hand over as artifacts.

Technical / artifact plan (what Redwood can provide):
- SOC2: redacted Type II report (control descriptions + auditor opinion). We can provide a PDF with vendor/redactable PII removed.
- Pen test: executive summary + remediation status (CSV of issues with severity and remediation date).
- Audit logs: screenshots of immutable audit trail UI + sample export (redacted JSON) showing retention TTL and WORM settings.
- KMS: private deployment supports customer-managed KMS via KMS/HSM integration; we’ll list supported providers and requirements.
- S3 export: we support push to a read-only S3 bucket with signed manifest for archive.

Proposed timeline:
- Nov 6: deliver redacted SOC2 summary + pen test executive summary (internal security review first).
- Nov 10: 30m retention & audit-demo (confirm 9:30–10:00 PST works for Veritas).
- Nov 12: Mutual Action Plan updated with artifact deliveries; Legal to exchange DPA redline after Veritas shares contact.

Aditya — can you confirm we can produce the remediation CSV and whether Legal needs any extra gating on the redacted report?

Attachments: retention-demo-slides.pdf

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

> On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 9:03 AM Elena Morales <elena@veritasbank.com> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call readout: SOC2/Retention & next steps — approvals

Nice recap and plan. A few notes from a PS/sales ops standpoint before we share externally: 

- Approve the artifact list and timeline (Nov 6 deliverables + Nov 10 demo). Good to move fast.
- Sales: prepare a simple MPA with milestones tied to artifact delivery and pilot start; include one-time onboarding credit we discussed (10% credit) as a gesture for the audit burden. Jordan, please add to the HubSpot deal and flag for Legal review.
- Legal: we will use DPA-template-redwood_v2.docx as the starting point; legal should expect a redline. Jordan — capture Veritas legal contact as soon as Elena shares it and loop Legal (cc: legal@redwood.com).
- Security: Aditya, own the evidence handoff. Please coordinate a secure S3 share or signed GDrive link for the redacted artifacts.

Attachments: DPA-template-redwood_v2.docx

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
